paragraphs: Rav Yitzḥak bar Adam—a scribal error; it should read bar Adda, chapter Pasin (20, end of side b). Bar Rav Adda, Sanhedrin (16b). Rav's student, Ḥullin (15, beginning of side b): he said, 'Rav said.'
